goals: Verify the uiFrPhoneNumberMask directive correctly formats French phone numbers for display and parses user input, specifically by ignoring non-digit characters, to update the model.
Verify the uiFrPhoneNumberMask directive properly integrates with ngModel by registering parsers and formatters, and handles cases where ngModel is not provided.
activities: Compile an input element with the 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' directive but without 'ng-model'.
Assert that compiling the input element throws an error.
Compile a basic input element with 'ng-model'.
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller for the basic input.
Compile an input element with 'ng-model' and the 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' directive.
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller for the masked input.
Assert that the masked input's '$parsers' array has one more entry than the basic input's.
Assert that the masked input's '$formatters' array has one more entry than the basic input's.
Compile an input element with the 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' directive, initializing its model with '3011201034'.
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller for the input.
Assert that the input's view value is '30 11 20 10 34'.
Compile an input element with the 'ui-fr-phone-number-mask' directive, allowing invalid model values.
Retrieve the 'ngModel' controller for the input.
Define a series of test cases, each including an input string, an expected view value, and an expected model value.
Set the input element's value to the test input string and trigger an 'input' event.
Assert that the 'ngModel's view value matches the expected view value for the current test case.
Assert that the 'ngModel's model value matches the expected model value for the current test case.
